provenance.integration: adaptive Simpson mechanical regen power integration with exact segment speed; energy balance allocation
provenance.source: accepted v0.5.0 braking branch, isolated extension
provenance.constraints: aggregate mu*m*g; regen limited by motor shaft torque × ideal ratio / radius, wheel mechanical power, battery power / efficiency
provenance.battery: assumed constant charge-power acceptance; not a calibrated battery, cell, SOC or temperature model
provenance.coordinate_convention: positive speed, positive braking forces/deceleration and positive battery charge energy
provenance.suspension_coupling: none; no changes to fixed-speed quarter-/half-car dynamics

warnings: Illustrative aggregate-friction model only: no wheel-specific grip, lockup, ABS, aero drag, rolling resistance, perception or reaction distance.
Axle normal loads use quasi-static straight-line load transfer; no pitch transients or measured tire forces.
Illustrative fixed motor/charge-power limits; no SOC, temperature, thermal protection, motor maps or axle-specific traction model.
Wheel-side mechanical torque = motor shaft torque × ideal gear ratio; a single assumed efficiency accounts for wheel-to-battery electrical conversion.
No ABS, wheel slip, dynamic brake bias, aerodynamic drag, rolling loss, brake temperature or physical EV validation.
Some braking demand is supplied by friction brakes because regeneration is constrained.
